title: Graph Weldings Associated with Functions in Zygmund, $\mathrm{BMO}$, $\mathrm{VMO}$, and $H^{1/2}$
summary: Let $f\colon \mathbb{R}\to\mathbb{R}$ be a continuous function. We define the graph welding associated with $f$ as the homeomorphism \[ \varphi = G^{-1}\circ F\colon \mathbb{R}\to\mathbb{R}. \] Here, $F(x)=x+if(x)$ parametrizes the graph of $f$, and $G$ is a conformal mapping from the upper half-plane $\mathbb{H}$ onto one of the two domains bounded by the graph of $f$, admitting a continuous extension to $\mathbb{R}$.
